title: DiCT: Teaching X-ray Vision-Language Models to Reason via Imagining CT
abstract: arXiv:2611.32344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diagnosing with X-rays often requires reasoning about the 3D locations of abnormalities and their spatial relationships to surrounding anatomical structures, yet such reasoning remains challenging due to the loss of spatial information in 2D projections. To address this challenge, we propose Dreaming in CT (DiCT), a three-stage progressive CT-to-X-ray reasoning transfer framework that leverages a CT vision-language model (VLM) to guide an X-ray VLM. Through this CT-guided transfer, the student acquires CT-informed 3D reasoning capabilities, enabling it to reason directly from 2D X-rays without explicit CT reconstruction at inference time. The framework begins with instruct the dreamer, which equips the X-ray student with initial CT-oriented reasoning capabilities and establishes a structured interface that distinguishes X-ray observations from CT imagination. Building on this structure, visualize the dream introduces CT-guided on-polic

translated_title: DiCT：通过想象CT教会X射线视觉-语言模型进行推理
translated_abstract: 使用X射线进行诊断通常需要对异常的3D位置及其与周围解剖结构的空间关系进行推理，但由于2D投影中空间信息的丢失，这类推理仍然具有挑战性。为解决这一难题，我们提出了Dreaming in CT（DiCT），一个三阶段的渐进式CT到X射线推理迁移框架，利用CT视觉-语言模型（VLM）来指导X射线VLM。通过这种CT引导的迁移，学生模型获得了受CT启发的3D推理能力，使其能够在推理时直接从2D X射线进行推理，而无需显式的CT重建。该框架首先通过“指导梦想家”阶段，为X射线学生模型赋予初始的CT导向推理能力，并建立一个结构化接口，将X射线观察与CT想象区分开来。在此结构基础上，“可视化梦境”阶段引入了CT引导的……
tldr: 提出DiCT三阶段渐进迁移框架，利用CT视觉-语言模型指导X射线模型学习3D空间推理，使其无需CT重建即可直接从2D X射线完成具有3D空间意识的诊断推理。
en_tdlr: DiCT is a three-stage progressive transfer framework that leverages a CT vision-language model to teach an X-ray VLM CT-informed 3D reasoning, enabling diagnosis directly from 2D X-rays without explicit CT reconstruction at inference time.
